mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% YoY signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPI YoY > 2% does not correlate with tightening monetary policy.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in Real Final Sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or RSAFS decline does not correlate with weakening consumer demand.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in one month signals labor market distress, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or UNRATE rise does not correlate with labor market distress.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in Industrial Production Index (INDPRO) by more than 1% in one month signals strengthening supply-side fundamentals, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or INDPRO increase does not correlate with strengthening supply-side fundamentals.

mechanism_narrative: When the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and CPIAUCSL YoY is above 2%, the combination signals a mismatch between inflation and monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between low FEDFUNDS and high CPIAUCSL does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in Housing Starts (HOUST) signals strengthening demand in the housing sector, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with strengthening housing demand.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 7% and Nonfarm Payrolls (PAYEMS) decline by more than 100,000 in a month, the combination signals a weakening labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 7% and PAYEMS declines > 100k in 1 month
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction between high UNRATE and declining PAYEMS does not correlate with negative returns.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, a 0.25% increase in the Federal Funds Rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or FEDFUNDS increase does not correlate with negative returns during tightening cycles.
